messages:
incident-bot: PAGE FIRED -> HIGH_ERROR_RATE: prod-eu-west1 /api/v1/generate 5xx spike (5m avg 18%) :rotating_light:
pagerduty-bot: Incident triggered: pd_inc_20260314_001 (priority: P1) assigned to irene (oncall)
irene (oncall): acked - I'm on it, oncall pinged via voice. Starting triage. :eyes:
mike (infra): looking at edge gateway metrics now. Any customer impact notes?
irene (oncall): latency stable, but 5xxs are mostly 502/504 from gateway -> inference-gateway. Rolling window shows region spike in eu-west1.
sam (runtime): checking model pods and backend pools - live autoscaler did not trigger yet. Could be connection exhaustion on gateway.
jules (support): CS flag: two paying customers reporting failed generation calls last 10m. Severity: retries surfaced as user-facing errors.
naya (prodops): adding temporary traffic steering to fallback pool in eu-west1 to reduce pressure. Will update routing policy.
mike (infra): I see TCP_BACKEND 503s on edge-nginx; keepalive connections high, upstreams returning 502 on new connections. Possible upstream thread exhaustion.
irene (oncall): runbook: gateway-5xx-spike -> step 1 check gateway pods, step 2 re-deploy gateway if unhealthy, step 3 shift traffic. I'm executing step 1.
sam (runtime): past 2 min, inference-gateway containers show high 95th loop time on accept, kernel-level backlog rising. Dumping recent logs: ```
[2026-03-14T09:07:31Z] inference-gateway ERROR accept connection: resource temporarily unavailable
[2026-03-14T09:07:33Z] inference-gateway WARN kvcache miss surge
[2026-03-14T09:07:35Z] inference-gateway ERROR upstream 10.2.5.7:443 502 Bad Gateway
```
mike (infra): Can we throttle keepalive or bump worker_rlimit? Quick patch: increase nginx worker_connections and enable reuseport.
nirene (oncall): I also see traffic pattern: spike in many small short-lived requests from a single client IP range. Could be a misbehaving customer or bot. Jules, can you check customer IDs?
jules (support): Customer A (acct_7421) and Customer B (acct_8853) show elevated error logs. Reached out to their SREs.
sam (runtime): For immediate relief I'm going to enable connection pooling on gateway -> runtime to reduce new TLS handshakes. Patching config now.
deploy-bot: Started deploy c7f3a - staging -> prod (gateway-config) by sam.
mike (infra): I'm scaling gateway replicas from 4 -> 8 in eu-west1. K8s HPA not hitting desired due to CPU being low; this is connection rate bound. Manual scaling now.
irene (oncall): applying temporary rate-limit pair rule to /api/v1/generate for 2xx only? Want to preserve successful requests. Maybe enforce per-IP burst limit 50/s. Sam and Mike ok with short window?
sam (runtime): OK to apply per-IP limit at edge for 15m. I'll also enable fallback-model routing for 10% of requests to lower-memory model to reduce per-request resource use.
naya (prodops): I've updated routing policy: 10% -> model-small, 90% -> model-prod; rate-limiter set. Monitoring.
mike (infra): gateway replicas up to 8, worker_connections increased. Observability shows backlog dropping. 5xx rate falling from 18% -> 7% in last 3 mins.
jules (support): customer A reports degradations improving. Customer B still seeing errors but reduced.
irene (oncall): good. keep an eye for error regression. I'll start postmortem doc skeleton now. We need cause, mitigation, followups (sticky conn limits, autoscale by connection, client-side guidance).
sam (runtime): adding metric alert for connection backlog > 500 to trigger autoscale. Also will add circuit-breaker to upstreams to fail fast on overloaded backends.
naya (prodops): Noted we should add a guardrail to avoid single-customer storms; propose token-bucket per-api-key at edge.
pagerduty-bot: Incident pd_inc_20260314_001 acknowledged by irene (oncall) at 2026-03-14T09:08:12Z
irene (oncall): I'm escalating to eng runbook leads for follow-up. Assigning owners: Sam -> runtime mitigations, Mike -> infra config & scaling, Naya -> routing & policy, Jules -> customer comms.
deploy-bot: Deploy c7f3a completed in prod-eu-west1 (gateway-config) by sam — rollout success.
mike (infra): 5xx now ~2% over last 1m. Keep monitoring for 15m.
jules (support): I'll send interim note to flagged customers: we mitigated a traffic surge, ask them to check client retry behavior and backoff.
irene (oncall): closing the page in PD when stable for 15m. Marking interim severity downgrade. Adding postmortem link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2026-0314 (skeleton)
sam (runtime): follow-up actions: improve KV cache eviction under surge, add autoscale by connection backlog, test fallback model QoS.
naya (prodops): I'll schedule a runbook update and a small chaos test to simulate short-lived connection storms.
irene (oncall): Thanks team. I'll hand off to followups and change to monitoring watch. If 5xx climbs again page will repro. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: RESOLVED alert: HIGH_ERROR_RATE -> condition returned to normal.
